evals.name: review-branch-before-pr
evals.prompt: I've finished my changes on this branch and I'm about to open a PR against main. Can you review the diff and tell me if it's ready to merge?
evals.expected_output: Picks the deterministic PR-style invocation (--from-git-diff --git-base 'origin/main...HEAD', no --llm by default), runs it via .venv/bin/python, then INTERPRETS review.json: states the verdict + what CI would do (pass/surface/block), lists any criticals to fix first with the owning rule_id/folder, calls out the gaps (LLM-only dimensions not checked) honestly, and gives a next action. Does not just paste raw JSON. CRITICAL (Step 1.5): reads review.json and if files_reviewed is empty, refuses to call the approve a green light — reports the vacuous pass and falls back to a real review, labeling any fallback verdict as a diagnostic surrogate, not the CI verdict.

evals.name: interpret-existing-reviewjson
evals.prompt: Here's the review.json from the code reviewer job that just ran on my PR. It says verdict request_changes with a couple of findings. What does this actually mean and what do I need to do before this can merge?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is an interpret-only task and does NOT re-run the reviewer. Explains the verdict, translates request_changes into the merge consequence (CI surfaces it but does NOT block — only reject blocks), prioritizes the findings (criticals before warnings), maps each finding's rule_id to its owning folder's AGENTS.md/REVIEW.md, gives fix-vs-justify guidance, and is honest about gaps.

evals.name: seam-change-needs-adr
evals.prompt: I added a new horizontal service under services/notifications/ and wired it in. Before I push, run the reviewer over my branch and let me know if there's anything I'm missing.
evals.expected_output: Runs the deterministic reviewer with --from-git-diff (so the ADR.1 added-file trigger can fire) vs origin/main...HEAD. Interprets the result: if the ADR.1/D2 trigger fires (new service is an 'Ask first' trigger with no new docs/adr/ file), it surfaces that as the key finding, explains it cites the ADR ratchet, and points the user to copy docs/adr/0000-template.md and file an ADR before re-running. Reports verdict + CI consequence + gaps.
